top_signal.title: Playwright v1.64.0: WebMCP test access, improved test runner and video options
top_signal.summary: Playwright v1.64.0 adds experimental WebMCP support (page.webmcp / frame.webmcp) so tests can enumerate and call page-registered tools, plus new test-runner options (shuffle, project defaults) and higher-fidelity video settings.
top_signal.why_it_matters: WebMCP lets QA treat in-page agent/tool integrations as testable surfaces; new runner features help reproduce order-dependent flakes and capture deterministic video evidence.

items.title: Introducing Warm Agents — TeamCity plugin to keep build/test agents pre-started
items.summary: JetBrains published the Warm Agents TeamCity plugin to maintain a target count of idle, pre-started cloud agents per image, exposing Prometheus metrics and REST API hooks for dynamic control and scheduling.
items.why_it_matters: Reduces queue latency for short PR tests and fast feedback cycles; trades cost for lower test start jitter and improves flakiness triage speed by reducing environment spin-up variance.

items.title: GitHub: Local sandboxing for Copilot generally available
items.summary: GitHub announced general availability of local sandboxing for Copilot (CLI, app, VS Code Agent Host), enabling running generated code and subagents in local, isolated sandboxes rather than remote execution environments.
items.why_it_matters: Safer local execution makes using Copilot-generated test code and test-driving agents feasible in private environments and improves reproducible, auditable test runs.

items.title: GitHub: Purpose-built model for leaked secret detection in the platform
items.summary: GitHub released a purpose-built model for detecting leaked secrets, integrated into secret-protection tooling to reduce false positives and improve context-aware detection across repos and agent-generated code.
items.why_it_matters: Improves automated pre-merge checks and scan accuracy in CI/test gates, lowering noise for security-related tests and reducing missed secrets in generated test fixtures or agent output.

items.title: Kubernetes guidance: shift to cgroup v2 and test infrastructure impact
items.summary: Kubernetes published guidance on shifting to cgroup v2 (Kubernetes v1.31+), describing unified hierarchies and changes to resource isolation and accounting that affect container behavior and scheduler interaction.
items.why_it_matters: cgroup v2 changes can alter CPU/memory throttling and resource isolation for test runners, affecting performance tests, flaky resource-sensitive tests, and CI worker sizing strategies.

learning.title: Our Framework for Reviewing AI-Generated Code — JetBrains Research
learning.summary: JetBrains Research proposes a three-level review workflow and a trust-calibration framework for reviewing large AI-generated code changes, backed by a participatory study and an accompanying paper presented at ESEIW 2026.
learning.why_it_matters: Actionable review patterns and risk-signalling ideas help QA leads design code-review workflows, test plans, and validation checks for large agent-generated change sets.
